lead: Length, card, limits, and the last day — as a short specification rather than as a paragraph nobody finishes.
note: The note is where the exceptions go: who to ask for an extension, and what support a trial gets.

terms.title: Each term is a question
terms.text: A description list, so the pairing survives being copied into an e-mail.

terms.title: The answer is short
terms.text: Anything longer belongs in the clarification below it.

terms.title: The clarification is optional
terms.text: A second value on the same term, so a term with a caveat still reads as one answer.

terms.title: The last day is stated
terms.text: It is the question every trial panel is really being read for.
